abilities.name: Data Scan
abilities.description: As a Basic Action, choose one enemy Digimon. You learn their Attribute (Vaccine, Data, Virus, Free, or Unknown).

abilities.name: Elemental Analysis
abilities.description: Data Scan also reveals the target's Element.

abilities.name: Wide Scan
abilities.description: You may use Data Scan at the start of the encounter without it costing an action.

abilities.name: Root Access
abilities.description: Add your Knowledge rank to the result of all Jack In skill checks.

abilities.name: Digimon Encyclopedia
abilities.description: Data Scan now targets every enemy Digimon in the encounter at once instead of just one.

abilities.name: Source Code
abilities.description: As your Basic Action, make a Jack In check against DN 20. On a success, you may change one minor thing about the Digital World in your immediate surroundings, such as cracking a boulder apart or causing a door into a nearby building to appear, that scale of edit. This can never be used to change anything about a Digimon, and it can't be used to make a major change to the environment around you, like turning a desert into an ocean.
